name.ro: Bilet valabil 60 minute prin aplicația 24pay, cursele spre Arcuș
name.hu: 60 percig érvényes jegy a 24pay alkalmazásban, árkosi járatokra

note: Arcuș is a separate commune, so line 10 crosses a fare boundary. Validity comes from the operator directly; the prices still come from the tariff page, which was wrong about the validity and may be stale about the amounts too. Șugaș Băi is treated as city because the resort belongs to Sfântu Gheorghe, unconfirmed.
